name: bbva
description: Maintain the user's private BBVA records and native macOS spending view without placing personal data in the plugin package.

interface.shortDescription: Private BBVA records and spending view
interface.longDescription: Own the user's BBVA statements, transactions, balances, account meaning, bank-linked products, and derived spending records through a private local store. The distributable plugin contains only the guarded workflow, schema, tests, and native macOS app.
defaultPrompt: Import BBVA documents into the private store
